headline: Mike Wallace, Who Wrote an Acclaimed History of New York, Dies at 83
context: His 1998 book, “Gotham,” which told the city’s story to 1898, focused on social and economic conflict. It won a Pulitzer Prize and inspired two sequels.

sources.name: The New York Times
